WorkspaceColourDto.description:
A workspace's colour as the wire reads it: a preset names itself and its
index (`{"preset": "sky", "index": 2, ...}`), a custom colour its hex
(`{"custom": "#3A7BD5", ...}`); both give the value painted in each theme.
No two workspaces hold identical colours (`workspace.colour.set`).

custom.description: The custom colour's `#RRGGBB`; absent on a preset.

index.description: The preset's place in the palette, as files store it.

preset.description: The preset's name in lower case; absent on a custom colour.

WorkspaceEntry.description: One workspace and the tabs using it.

colour.description: Its colour. Additive: absent from a build that predates colours.

summary.description:
One line: the panes, each context pane's interval and the indicator
count, e.g. `Time 1m · Flow · 3 ind`.

description: Every workspace, `Default` first, then by name.
